title: Mechanics of Materials
tagline: Stress and strain, axial load, torsion, shear-force and bending-moment diagrams, bending and shear stresses, stress transformation, beam deflection and buckling
summary: Mechanics of materials asks how much a loaded member deforms and when it will fail. Starting from stress, strain and Hooke's law, the course treats axially loaded bars, torsion of shafts, shear-force and bending-moment diagrams, bending and shear stresses in beams, combined loading, pressure vessels and stress transformation with Mohr's circle, the deflection of beams and the buckling of columns.

chapters.title: Stress and strain
chapters.summary: Normal and shear stress and strain, Hooke's law and Poisson's ratio, allowable stresses and factors of safety.

chapters.title: Axially loaded members
chapters.summary: Elongation of bars, statically indeterminate members, thermal stresses and stress concentrations.

chapters.title: Torsion
chapters.summary: Shear stress and angle of twist in circular shafts, power transmission and statically indeterminate shafts.

chapters.title: Shear-force and bending-moment diagrams
chapters.summary: Internal forces in beams, the relations between load, shear force and bending moment, and drawing the diagrams.

chapters.title: Bending stress
chapters.summary: The flexure formula, beams of composite and unsymmetric section, and the design of beams for bending.

chapters.title: Shear stresses in beams
chapters.summary: The shear formula, the distribution of shear stress over common sections, and shear flow in built-up members.

chapters.title: Combined loading and stress transformation
chapters.summary: Thin-walled pressure vessels, combined axial, torsional and bending loads, plane stress transformation, principal stresses and Mohr's circle.

chapters.title: Deflection of beams
chapters.summary: The elastic curve by integration, discontinuity functions and superposition, and statically indeterminate beams.

chapters.title: Buckling of columns
chapters.summary: Euler buckling of ideal columns, end conditions and effective length, eccentric loading and the design of columns.
